notes.content: Students must earn a "C-" grade or higher in all courses required in the major. The Associate Degree for Transfer (ADT) in Communication Studies is compatible with the B.A. in Public Relations at Sacramento State. Students pursuing the Associate Degree for Transfer must complete all lower-division major coursework with a "C" or better. Prior to acceptance as a Public Relations major, students must complete a pre-major consisting of all required lower-division courses plus the upper-division survey course (COMS 100A) and upper-division research methodology course (COMS 100C). COMS 100A and COMS 100C must be taken at Sacramento State. All Communication Studies majors are required to complete at least one 3 unit public speaking course such as COMS 4 or a transfer equivalent. Public speaking courses taken to fulfill the CSU GE Area 1C Oral Communication requirement also fulfill this Department requirement. Communication Studies courses may only be repeated once for a grade change. Students who fail to achieve at least a "C-" in two attempts in a core course will be disqualified in majoring in Public Relations. The department also offers a degree in Communication Studies. See the "Communication Studies, BA" for additional information. For additional information, please visit: Department of Communication Studies .
